text:
Supply order for Ellmere depot.
Personnel: Bram out (Greta out rest of week; Rafe covering); Dell out (Rafe covering); Jonah/Bram swapping desks. Pia/Leon swapping desks. Greta covers Mira (out all week). Cora/Mira swapping desks. Suri/Nils swapping desks. Una/Vik swapping desks. Leon out rest of week (Nils covering); Teo covers Una (out rest of week). Rafe, Vik, Wren involved.
Issues: Lifts near loading bay, east wing, north office, print room, library annex, garden studio, and harbour room are slow. East wing too cold in afternoon/evening. Garden studio, loading bay, harbour room, and east wing being repainted (noise). Umbrella left in loading bay, garden studio, and north office. Mira/Una think north office too cold evening. Hugo thinks harbour room too cold morning.
Order items: 515 crates; 400 ladders.
Notes: Finn, Mira, Teo, Suri want north office/loading bay/garden studio clear for visitors. Ines, Leon prefer east wing for reviews. Bram, Kira prefer loading bay. Teo, Ada prefer garden studio. Wren prefers north office. Opal asked if print room free morning; prefers loading bay/harbour room. Bram prefers library annex. Coffee machines in north office, library annex, loading bay working. Morning stand-up moved to harbour room. Afternoon stand-up moved to print room. Print room being repainted (noise). User needs to send Esme, Mira, Opal, Vik, Kira morning meeting notes; Jonah afternoon notes. Assistant offered to draft note to Greta. Check with Kira/Hugo before morning meeting; Leon before afternoon meeting. Rafe prefers print room for reviews. East wing repainting causes morning noise. User must send Hugo morning meeting notes. North office lift is slow today. User must send Cora evening meeting notes. Una prefers harbour room for reviews. Dell prefers harbour room for reviews. User must send Kira evening meeting notes. Nils wants north office kept clear for visitors. Hugo wants library annex kept clear for visitors. Leon wants harbour room kept clear for visitors. Rafe asked if north office is free in afternoon.
